claims: Queens University of Charlotte is a private liberal arts university.
Queens University of Charlotte is located in Charlotte, North Carolina.
Queens University of Charlotte is located in the historic Myers Park neighborhood.
Queens University of Charlotte is located approximately three miles from downtown Charlotte.
Queens University of Charlotte is located at 1900 Selwyn Ave, Charlotte, NC 28274.
Queens University of Charlotte had a recent NCAA Tournament appearance (March Madness).
Queens University of Charlotte has a planned 2026 merger with Elon University.
Queens University of Charlotte offers undergraduate programs.
Queens University of Charlotte offers graduate programs.
Queens University of Charlotte is different from Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, Canada.
Queens University of Charlotte is different from the City University of New York's (CUNY) Queens College in Flushing, NY.
